ayahs.arabicText: طٰسٓمّٓ
ayahs.translation: Ta'. Sin. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: تِلْكَ اٰیٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِیْنِ
ayahs.translation: These are the verses of the Clear Book.

ayahs.arabicText: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ اَلَّا یَكُوْنُوْا مُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), you will perhaps grieve yourself to death because these people do not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ نَّشَاْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَیْهِمْ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اٰیَةً فَظَلَّتْ اَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خٰضِعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: If We will, We can send down a Sign to them from heaven, so their necks will be humbled to it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یَاْتِیْهِمْ مِّنْ ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Never does there come to them an admonition from the Merciful Lord but they turn away from it.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوْا فَسَیَاْتِیْهِمْ اَنْۢبٰٓؤُا مَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ یَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will soon come to know the truth of that which they have been scoffing at.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اِلَى الْاَرْضِ كَمْ اَنْۢبَتْنَا فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Do they not look at the earth, how We caused a variety of fine vegetation to grow from it (in abundance)?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Infinitely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذْ نَادٰى رَبُّكَ مُوْسٰۤى اَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (Recount to them about the time) when Your Lord called Moses: "Go to the wrong-doing people,

ayahs.arabicText: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ١ؕ اَلَا یَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: the people of Pharaoh: do they have no fear?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ اَنْ یُّكَذِّبُوْنِؕ
ayahs.translation: He said: "My Lord! I fear that they will brand me a liar.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَضِیْقُ صَدْرِیْ وَ لَا یَنْطَلِقُ لِسَانِیْ فَاَرْسِلْ اِلٰى هٰرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: My breast is constricted and my tongue is not fluent, so endow Messengership on Aaron.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَهُمْ عَلَیَّ ذَنْۢبٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنْ یَّقْتُلُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: As for me, they hold the charge of a crime against me. I fear they will put me to death."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ كَلَّا١ۚ فَاذْهَبَا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اِنَّا مَعَكُمْ مُّسْتَمِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said: "Certainly not! So go both of you with Our Signs. We shall be with you listening to everything.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاْتِیَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُوْلَاۤ اِنَّا رَسُوْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Go, then, to Pharaoh and say to him: 'The Lord of the Universe has sent us

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ اَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَؕ
ayahs.translation: that you let the Children of Israel go with us.'"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِیْنَا وَلِیْدًا وَّ لَبِثْتَ فِیْنَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: "Did we not bring you up among us when you were a child?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ فَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِیْ فَعَلْتَ وَ اَنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: You spent many years of your life among us and then you committed that deed of yours. You are very ungrateful indeed."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَاۤ اِذًا وَّ اَنَا مِنَ الضَّآلِّیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: "I committed that act erringly.

ayahs.arabicText: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنْكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِیْ رَبِّیْ حُكْمًا وَّ جَعَلَنِیْ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then I fled for fear of you. Then my Lord bestowed wisdom and authority on me and made me one of the Messengers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَیَّ اَنْ عَبَّدْتَّ بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَؕ
ayahs.translation: Now this is the favour that you tauntingly remind me of: that you enslaved the Children of Israel!"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَ مَا رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: "And who is this Lord of the Universe?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا١ؕ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُّوْقِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Moses answered: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between them, if you were only to believe."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهٗۤ اَلَا تَسْتَمِعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said to those around him: "Do you hear (what he says)?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَ رَبُّ اٰبَآئِكُمُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "(He is) Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers of yore."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوْلَكُمُ الَّذِیْۤ اُرْسِلَ اِلَیْكُمْ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said to the audience: "This Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is simply mad."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا١ؕ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Moses continued: "(He is) the Lord of the east and the west, and all between them. If you only had any understanding!"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ اِلٰهًا غَیْرِیْ لَاَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُوْنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: "If you take any god other than me, I will certainly make you one of those (who are rotting) in prison."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَوَ لَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَیْءٍ مُّبِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "Even if I were to bring a Clear Sign to you?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ فَاْتِ بِهٖۤ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: "Then bring it if you are truthful at all."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَلْقٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِیَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِیْنٌۚۖ
ayahs.translation: (No sooner had he said this than) Moses threw down his rod and behold, it was a veritable serpent,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ نَزَعَ یَدَهٗ فَاِذَا هِیَ بَیْضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and he drew his hand (out of his armpit) and lo! it had become a shining object to the beholders.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لِلْمَلَاِ حَوْلَهٗۤ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِیْمٌۙ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said to the nobles around him: "Surely this man is a skilled magician

ayahs.arabicText: یُّرِیْدُ اَنْ یُّخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنْ اَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهٖ١ۖۗ فَمَا ذَا تَاْمُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: who wants to drive you out of your land by his magic. Tell us, what do you advise us?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اَرْجِهْ وَ اَخَاهُ وَ ابْعَثْ فِی الْمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Detain him and his brother for a while and send forth heralds to the cities

ayahs.arabicText: یَاْتُوْكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: to mobilise all skilled magicians."

ayahs.arabicText: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِیْقَاتِ یَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: So the magicians were brought together on a particular day at a set time

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ قِیْلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ اَنْتُمْ مُّجْتَمِعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and the people were told: "Will you join the assembly?

ayahs.arabicText: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ اِنْ كَانُوْا هُمُ الْغٰلِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We may perhaps follow the religion of the magicians if they triumph."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوْا لِفِرْعَوْنَ اَئِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجْرًا اِنْ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغٰلِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: When the magicians came forth (for the encounter) they said to Pharaoh: "Is there a reward for us if we triumph?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَ اِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said: "Yes, you will then become those near-stationed to me."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ لَهُمْ مُّوْسٰۤى اَلْقُوْا مَاۤ اَنْتُمْ مُّلْقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Moses said to them: "Throw down whatever you wish to throw."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَ عِصِیَّهُمْ وَ قَالُوْا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ اِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon they threw down their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the glory of Pharaoh, we shall prevail."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَلْقٰى مُوْسٰى عَصَاهُ فَاِذَا هِیَ تَلْقَفُ مَا یَاْفِكُوْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: Thereafter, Moses threw down his rod and behold, it went about swallowing up all the false devices they had contrived.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاُلْقِیَ السَّحَرَةُ سٰجِدِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon the magicians fell down in prostration,

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: saying: "We (now) believe in the Lord of the Universe,

ayahs.arabicText: رَبِّ مُوْسٰى وَ هٰرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اٰمَنْتُمْ لَهٗ قَبْلَ اَنْ اٰذَنَ لَكُمْ١ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكَبِیْرُكُمُ الَّذِیْ عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ١ۚ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ١ؕ۬ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَیْدِیَكُمْ وَ اَرْجُلَكُمْ مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَّ لَاُوصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ اَجْمَعِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: "You accepted the word of Moses even before I granted you the leave to do so. Surely he is your chief who has taught you magic. Soon shall you come to know. I shall cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides and shall crucify all of you."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَا ضَیْرَ١٘ اِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا مُنْقَلِبُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: They said: "We do not care, for we are bound to return to our Lord,

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا نَطْمَعُ اَنْ یَّغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰیٰنَاۤ اَنْ كُنَّاۤ اَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَؕ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and we surely expect that Our Lord will forgive us our sins for we are the first ones to believe."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوْسٰۤى اَنْ اَسْرِ بِعِبَادِیْۤ اِنَّكُمْ مُّتَّبَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We revealed to Moses: "Set forth with My servants by night for you will be pursued."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِی الْمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities (to mobilise troops)

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِیْلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: saying: "These (Israelites) are only a small band of people

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who have certainly provoked our wrath.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّا لَجَمِیْعٌ حٰذِرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: But we are a numerous host, ever on guard."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخْرَجْنٰهُمْ مِّنْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ عُیُوْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Thus did We drive them out of their gardens and springs

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ كُنُوْزٍ وَّ مَقَامٍ كَرِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: and their treasures and excellent dwellings.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ١ؕ وَ اَوْرَثْنٰهَا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَؕ
ayahs.translation: This happened with them; (but on the other hand), We enabled the Children of Israel to inherit those bounties.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَتْبَعُوْهُمْ مُّشْرِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: At sunrise they set off in pursuit of them

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَ الْجَمْعٰنِ قَالَ اَصْحٰبُ مُوْسٰۤى اِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and when the groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out: "We are overtaken!"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ كَلَّا١ۚ اِنَّ مَعِیَ رَبِّیْ سَیَهْدِیْنِ
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "Certainly not. My Lord is with me; He will direct me."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوْسٰۤى اَنِ اضْرِبْ بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ١ؕ فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِیْمِۚ
ayahs.translation: Then We revealed to Moses, (commanding him): "Strike the sea with your rod." Thereupon the sea split up, and then each became like the mass of a huge mount.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْاٰخَرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: We also brought the other party close to the same spot,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْجَیْنَا مُوْسٰى وَ مَنْ مَّعَهٗۤ اَجْمَعِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and We delivered Moses and his companions, all of them,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَغْرَقْنَا الْاٰخَرِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: then We drowned the others.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتْلُ عَلَیْهِمْ نَبَاَ اِبْرٰهِیْمَۘ
ayahs.translation: And recount to them the story of Abraham:

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِیْهِ وَ قَوْمِهٖ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: when he asked his father and his people: "What do you worship?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا نَعْبُدُ اَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عٰكِفِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They answered: "There are some idols that we worship and are devoted to them with constancy."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ هَلْ یَسْمَعُوْنَكُمْ اِذْ تَدْعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: He asked: "Do they hear you when you call them

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْ یَنْفَعُوْنَكُمْ اَوْ یَضُرُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: or do they cause you any benefit or harm?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا بَلْ وَجَدْنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا كَذٰلِكَ یَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They answered: "No; but we found our forefathers doing so."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَفَرَءَیْتُمْ مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon, Abraham said: "Have you seen (with your eyes) those whom you have been worshipping,

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْتُمْ وَ اٰبَآؤُكُمُ الْاَقْدَمُوْنَ٘ۖ
ayahs.translation: you and your forefathers of yore?

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّیْۤ اِلَّا رَبَّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They are all enemies to me; all, except the Lord of the Universe

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْ خَلَقَنِیْ فَهُوَ یَهْدِیْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: Who created me and Who guides me;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْ هُوَ یُطْعِمُنِیْ وَ یَسْقِیْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: Who gives me food and drink,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ یَشْفِیْنِ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: and Who, when I am ill, heals me;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْ یُمِیْتُنِیْ ثُمَّ یُحْیِیْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: Who will cause me to die and then will again restore me to life;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْۤ اَطْمَعُ اَنْ یَّغْفِرَ لِیْ خَطِیْٓئَتِیْ یَوْمَ الدِّیْنِؕ
ayahs.translation: Who, I hope, will forgive me my sins on the Day of Judgement."

ayahs.arabicText: رَبِّ هَبْ لِیْ حُكْمًا وَّ اَلْحِقْنِیْ بِالصّٰلِحِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (And then Abraham prayed): "My Lord, endow me with knowledge and wisdom and join me with the righteous,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اجْعَلْ لِّیْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِی الْاٰخِرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and grant me an honourable reputation among posterity,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اجْعَلْنِیْ مِنْ وَّرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: and make me of those who will inherit the Garden of Bliss,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اغْفِرْ لِاَبِیْۤ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and forgive my father for he is among those who strayed,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تُخْزِنِیْ یَوْمَ یُبْعَثُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and disgrace me not on the Day when people will be raised to life,

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ لَا یَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَّ لَا بَنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: the Day when nothing will avail, neither wealth nor offspring,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ اَتَى اللّٰهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِیْمٍؕ
ayahs.translation: but only he that brings to Allah a sound heart will (attain to success)."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (On that Day) the Garden will be brought near to the God-fearing,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ بُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِیْمُ لِلْغٰوِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and the Fire will be uncovered for those who strayed,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قِیْلَ لَهُمْ اَیْنَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and they will be asked: "Where are the gods that you worshipped

ayahs.arabicText: مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ١ؕ هَلْ یَنْصُرُوْنَكُمْ اَوْ یَنْتَصِرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: beside Allah? Can they be of any help to you, or even be of any help to themselves?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَكُبْكِبُوْا فِیْهَا هُمْ وَ الْغَاوٗنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Then the idols and those who strayed will be hurled into the Fire headlong, one upon another,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جُنُوْدُ اِبْلِیْسَ اَجْمَعُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: and so too the hosts of Iblis, all of them.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا وَ هُمْ فِیْهَا یَخْتَصِمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: There they will quarrel with one another and the erring ones will say (to their deities):

ayahs.arabicText: تَاللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنَّا لَفِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: "By Allah, we were surely in clear error

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ نُسَوِّیْكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: when we assigned to you a position equal to that of the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَضَلَّنَاۤ اِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is none but those steeped in guilt who led us into this error,

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَا لَنَا مِنْ شَافِعِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and now we have none to intercede on our behalf,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا صَدِیْقٍ حَمِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: nor do we have a truly sincere friend.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَوْ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: If only we could return we would be among the believers."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوْحِ اِ۟لْمُرْسَلِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: The people of Noah gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ نُوْحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Recall when their brother Noah said to them: "Do you have no fear?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you;

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: so fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ١ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: I seek of you no reward for this: my reward is with none except the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِؕ
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَ اتَّبَعَكَ الْاَرْذَلُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: They answered: "Shall we accept you even though it is the meanest of people who follow you?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ وَ مَا عِلْمِیْ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: "What knowledge do I have about their deeds?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّیْ لَوْ تَشْعُرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: It is only for my Lord to take account of them. Would that you made use of your understanding!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: It is not for me to repel those who choose to believe.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ اَنَا اِلَّا نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌؕ
ayahs.translation: I am none but a plain warner."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ یٰنُوْحُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُوْمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: They said: "O Noah! If you do not desist, you will certainly become one of the accursed."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنَّ قَوْمِیْ كَذَّبُوْنِۚۖ
ayahs.translation: He said: "My Lord! My people have branded me a liar.

ayahs.arabicText: فَافْتَحْ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَّ نَجِّنِیْ وَ مَنْ مَّعِیَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So pass a clear judgement between me and them and rescue me and the believers with me."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَنْجَیْنٰهُ وَ مَنْ مَّعَهٗ فِی الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: Thereafter We rescued him and those who were with him in the laden Ark

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبٰقِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: and drowned the rest.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Ever Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ عَادُ اِ۟لْمُرْسَلِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: The Ad gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ هُوْدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Recall, when their brother Hud said to them: "Have you no fear?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ١ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: I seek of you no reward for this; my reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: اَتَبْنُوْنَ بِكُلِّ رِیْعٍ اٰیَةً تَعْبَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: What, you build a monument on every hill merely for fun

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَتَّخِذُوْنَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and erect huge palaces as though you will live for ever,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and when you strike you strike like tyrants?

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتَّقُوا الَّذِیْۤ اَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Have fear of Him Who has provided you with all the (good) things you know;

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَدَّكُمْ بِاَنْعَامٍ وَّ بَنِیْنَۚۙ
ayahs.translation: Who has provided you with flocks and children

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ عُیُوْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: and with gardens and springs.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیْكُمْ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ عَظِیْمٍؕ
ayahs.translation: I fear for you the chastisement of an Awesome Day."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا سَوَآءٌ عَلَیْنَاۤ اَوَ عَظْتَ اَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْوٰعِظِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They replied: "It is all the same for us whether you admonish us or not.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا خُلُقُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: This has been happening all along.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: We will not be subjected to any chastisement."

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Eventually they gave the lie to him and We destroyed them. Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُوْدُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: The Thamud gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Recall when their brother Salih said to them: "Have you no fear?"

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ١ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: I ask of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: اَتُتْرَكُوْنَ فِیْ مَا هٰهُنَاۤ اٰمِنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you believe that you will be left here to live securely in the present state

ayahs.arabicText: فِیْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّ عُیُوْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: amidst gardens and springs

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ زُرُوْعٍ وَّ نَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِیْمٌۚ
ayahs.translation: and cornfields and date-palms laden with juicy fruits?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَنْحِتُوْنَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُیُوْتًا فٰرِهِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: You hew dwellings in mountains and exult in that.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: Fear Allah and obey me

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تُطِیْعُوْۤا اَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and do not follow the biddings of those that go to excesses

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یُفْسِدُوْنَ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا یُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and spread mischief in the land rather than set things right."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنَّمَاۤ اَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: They replied: "You are nothing but one of those who are bewitched;

ayahs.arabicText: مَاۤ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا١ۖۚ فَاْتِ بِاٰیَةٍ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: you are no different from a mortal like us. So produce a sign if you are truthful."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ هٰذِهٖ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَّ لَكُمْ شِرْبُ یَوْمٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍۚ
ayahs.translation: Salih said: "This is a she-camel. There is a day set for her to drink and there is a day set for you to drink.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَمَسُّوْهَا بِسُوْٓءٍ فَیَاْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ یَوْمٍ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Do not molest her lest the chastisement of an Awesome Day should seize you."

ayahs.arabicText: فَعَقَرُوْهَا فَاَصْبَحُوْا نٰدِمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: But they hamstrung her and then regretted it.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ١ؕ اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So the chastisement seized them. Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوْطِ اِ۟لْمُرْسَلِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: The people of Lot rejected the Messengers, branding them liars.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ اَخُوْهُمْ لُوْطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Recall, when their brother Lot said to them: "Have you no fear?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ١ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: I seek of you no reward. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: اَتَاْتُوْنَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: What, of all creation will you go to (fornicate with) the males,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَذَرُوْنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْ١ؕ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ عٰدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: leaving aside those whom Allah has created for you as your mates. Nay, you are a people that has transgressed all limits."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ یٰلُوْطُ لَتَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said: "O Lot! If you do not desist, you will be one of those expelled (from our towns)."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنِّیْ لِعَمَلِكُمْ مِّنَ الْقَالِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: He said: "I am one of those who abhor your practice.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبِّ نَجِّنِیْ وَ اَهْلِیْ مِمَّا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: My Lord, deliver me and my family from their wicked deeds."

ayahs.arabicText: فَنَجَّیْنٰهُ وَ اَهْلَهٗۤ اَجْمَعِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Then We delivered him and all his family

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا عَجُوْزًا فِی الْغٰبِرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: except an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْاٰخَرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Thereafter, We utterly destroyed the rest,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمْطَرْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ مَّطَرًا١ۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and We sent upon them a rain, an evil rain that fell on those who had been warned.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذَّبَ اَصْحٰبُ لْئَیْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: The people of Aykah also gave the lie to the Messengers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَیْبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Recall, when Shuayb said to them: "Have you no fear?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ لَكُمْ رَسُوْلٌ اَمِیْنٌۙ
ayahs.translation: I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوْنِۚ
ayahs.translation: So fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَسْئَلُكُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ اَجْرٍ١ۚ اِنْ اَجْرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰى رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: I ask of you no reward for this. My reward is with none but the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوْفُوا الْكَیْلَ وَ لَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Fill up the measure and do not diminish the goods of people,

ayahs.arabicText: وَزِنُوْا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِیْمِۚ
ayahs.translation: weigh with an even balance

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشْیَآءَهُمْ وَ لَا تَعْثَوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ مُفْسِدِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and do not deliver short, and do not go about creating mischief in the land,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتَّقُوا الَّذِیْ خَلَقَكُمْ وَ الْجِبِلَّةَ الْاَوَّلِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: and have fear of Him Who created you and the earlier generations."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا اِنَّمَاۤ اَنْتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They said: "You are no more than one of those who have been bewitched,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَنْتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَ اِنْ نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: you are only a mortal like us. Indeed we believe that you are an utter liar.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَسْقِطْ عَلَیْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: So cause a piece of the sky to fall upon us if you are truthful."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّیْۤ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Shuayb said: "My Lord knows well all what you do."

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ یَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ عَذَابَ یَوْمٍ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Then they branded him a liar, whereupon the chastisement of the Day of Canopy overtook them. It was the chastisement of a very awesome day.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیَةً١ؕ وَ مَا كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely there is a Sign in this, but most of them would not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الرَّحِیْمُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Verily Your Lord is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهٗ لَتَنْزِیْلُ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed this is a revelation from the Lord of the Universe;

ayahs.arabicText: نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوْحُ الْاَمِیْنُۙ
ayahs.translation: which the truthful spirit has carried down

ayahs.arabicText: عَلٰى قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: to your heart that you might become one of those who warn (others on behalf of Allah),

ayahs.arabicText: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِیٍّ مُّبِیْنٍؕ
ayahs.translation: (a revelation) in clear Arabic language,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّهٗ لَفِیْ زُبُرِ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (a revelation embodied) in the scriptures of the ancients.

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَكُنْ لَّهُمْ اٰیَةً اَنْ یَّعْلَمَهٗ عُلَمٰٓؤُا بَنِیْۤ اِسْرَآءِیْلَؕ
ayahs.translation: Is it not a Sign to them - (to wit, the Makkans) - that the learned men of the Children of Israel know that?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ نَزَّلْنٰهُ عَلٰى بَعْضِ الْاَعْجَمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (But such is their adamance) that had We revealed it to one of the non-Arabs and even if he had recited (this clear Arabic discourse) to them

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَرَاَهٗ عَلَیْهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ مُؤْمِنِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: they would still not have believed in it.

ayahs.arabicText: كَذٰلِكَ سَلَكْنٰهُ فِیْ قُلُوْبِ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Thus have We caused this (Admonition) to penetrate the hearts of the culprits (like a hot rod).

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ حَتّٰى یَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْاَلِیْمَۙ
ayahs.translation: They will not believe in it until they clearly see the grievous chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: فَیَاْتِیَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَّ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: But when it comes upon them suddenly, taking them unawares,

ayahs.arabicText: فَیَقُوْلُوْا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنْظَرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: they say: "Can we be granted some respite?"

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَبِعَذَابِنَا یَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they really want Our chastisement to be expedited?

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَرَءَیْتَ اِنْ مَّتَّعْنٰهُمْ سِنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Did you consider that if We were to let them enjoy life for many years

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یُوْعَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and then the chastisement of which they were being warned were to come upon them,

ayahs.arabicText: مَاۤ اَغْنٰى عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یُمَتَّعُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: of what avail will be the provisions of life which they have been granted to enjoy?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْیَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنْذِرُوْنَ٥ۗۛۖ
ayahs.translation: We never destroyed any habitation but that it had warners

ayahs.arabicText: ذِكْرٰى١ۛ۫ وَ مَا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: to admonish them. We have never been unjust.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّیٰطِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: The satans did not bring down this (Clear Book),

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یَنْۢبَغِیْ لَهُمْ وَ مَا یَسْتَطِیْعُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: nor does it behove them, nor does it lie in their power.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُوْلُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed they are debarred from even hearing it.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: So do not call any other god beside Allah lest you become of those who will be punished,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْذِرْ عَشِیْرَتَكَ الْاَقْرَبِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and warn your nearest kinsmen;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and be meek to the believers who follow you.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ اِنِّیْ بَرِیْٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Then if they disobey you say to them: "I am quit of what you do."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِیْزِ الرَّحِیْمِۙ
ayahs.translation: And put your trust in Him Who is Immensely Mighty, Most Compassionate,

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْ یَرٰىكَ حِیْنَ تَقُوْمُۙ
ayahs.translation: Who observes you when you rise (to pray)

ayahs.arabicText: وَ تَقَلُّبَكَ فِی السّٰجِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and observes your movements among those who prostrate themselves.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: He is All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: هَلْ اُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلٰى مَنْ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّیٰطِیْنُؕ
ayahs.translation: O people, shall I tell you on whom it is that satans descend?

ayahs.arabicText: تَنَزَّلُ عَلٰى كُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِیْمٍۙ
ayahs.translation: They descend on every forgerer steeped in sin,

ayahs.arabicText: یُّلْقُوْنَ السَّمْعَ وَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ كٰذِبُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: on those who whisper hearsay in the ears of people; and most of them are liars.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الشُّعَرَآءُ یَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوٗنَؕ
ayahs.translation: As for poets, only the wayward follow them.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّهُمْ فِیْ كُلِّ وَادٍ یَّهِیْمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that they wander about in every valley

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنَّهُمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ مَا لَا یَفْعَلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: and say things which they do not act upon,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ ذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ كَثِیْرًا وَّ انْتَصَرُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْا١ؕ وَ سَیَعْلَمُ الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْۤا اَیَّ مُنْقَلَبٍ یَّنْقَلِبُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: except those who believed and acted righteously and remembered Allah much, and when they themselves were subjected to wrong, they exacted retribution no more than to the extent of the wrong? Soon will the wrong-doers know the end that they shall reach.
